mindfront_eyelashes_01.author: Mindfront
mindfront_eyelashes_01.description: Mesh high poly eyelashes as an alternative to low poly textured. Instead of using Blender particle eyelashes I decided to make them as mesh to be reusable through MakeHuman. Each hair is non-manifold triangular and goes about 1 mm into the head to avoid visible gaps when posing. No texture is needed but they are UV-unwrapped project from view. The preview render is on a default neutral character using subsurf x1 and a simple cycles material.
